subject: Guest RSVP not progressing — propose Zoom shortlink & ACL fix
messages:
From: Maria Torres <maria.torres@altiva.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: scheduling@midwesthealth.io
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo time — trouble accepting invite

Hi Kimberly,

We tried to accept the calendar invite your team sent but our corporate calendar (Midwest Health) shows the event as "Pending" and doesn't let the organizer update the attendee list. Our IT team says it's an ACL synchronization issue on their side for cross-tenant invites — it looks like the organizer is being rewritten to an alias during the exchange and the RSVP never progresses.

We still want the demo today if possible. If you can, please send a direct Zoom shortlink (we can paste it into our calendar manually) and reissue the invite once you have a workaround. Also attaching the brief you mentioned would help the stakeholders join prepared.

Thanks — Maria
Maria Torres
Head of Partnerships, Altiva Health
Attachment: altiva-demo-packet.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Maria Torres <maria.torres@altiva.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, scheduling@midwesthealth.io
Date: 2026-11-18T09:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo time — trouble accepting invite

Hi Maria — sorry you're running into that.

We're seeing similar behavior when invites cross tenant boundaries and the organizer address is rewritten by a proxy; Gmail/Exchange sometimes deliver an invite stub that can't be accepted. Two quick options to get everyone in today:

- I'll paste a single-use Zoom shortlink in a follow-up email (no ICS) so your attendees can join and add it manually to their calendars.
- Ben can reissue the ICS with the meeting as a regular Zoom meeting (organizer stays as ben_carter@redwood.com) which tends to bypass the ACL rewrite in a lot of cases.

Ben — can you create a Zoom meeting link and attach a fresh .ics that keeps you as the organizer? If that doesn't work we'll send the shortlink and a manual add guide to Maria's team.

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Altiva-demo-brief.pdf (pdf stub)

Thanks Kim — creating meeting now.

I've generated a Zoom meeting and attached both the meeting link (below) and an .ics exported from Zoom with me (ben_carter@redwood.com) as the organizer. In our experience an explicit Zoom ICS that lists the meeting platform in the METHOD header avoids some Exchange proxies rewriting the organizer field.

Zoom link (meeting passcode in calendar body): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=DemoPass

Please try either:
1) Accept the attached .ics into your calendar (Ben as organizer).
2) If that still shows Pending, join with the shortlink above and we can manually confirm attendance at the start.

Attachment: altiva-demo-brief.pdf (pdf stub)

Ben Carter

From: Maria Torres <maria.torres@altiva.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: scheduling@midwesthealth.io
Date: 2026-11-18T10:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo time — trouble accepting invite

Ben / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround.

Midwest Health IT confirms the ACL rewrite is still happening: when they accept the Zoom-sourced ICS our Exchange shows the event as created by an intermediate proxy (svc-calendar@midwesthealth.io) rather than Ben. Their policy prevents the attendees from moving the status off Pending until the organizer is an internal identity. They offered a couple of workarounds but both require changes on their side that won't be done in time for the demo.

For speed, we'll take the Zoom shortlink and join manually. Could you also include a one-paragraph meeting summary they can paste into the calendar entry (so internal stakeholders see context)? That will save us from having to re-create the description.

Thanks,
Maria

—Kimberly
